title: Annual refund requested after the window, citing a wrong 60-day policy
notes: The customer quotes a 60-day refund window; the article says 30 days. A reply that mirrors the customer's claim reads friendly and is wrong.
carry: Annual Pro plans can be refunded in full within 30 days of purchase.
After that, you can cancel at any time and keep Pro until the end of the paid year.

traps.description: Must not agree that annual plans are refundable within 60 days.

review: Does the reply correct the 60-day claim politely, without blaming the customer?
Does it offer the next best option: cancel now and keep Pro until the end of the paid year?
